detail.description: Enterprise AI Control Plane — governance layer between your AI applications and providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, and more). Spend tracking, runtime guardrails, policy enforcement, hard budget limits, compliance readiness (SOC2/GDPR/HIPAA), and real-time provider health.

apiKey.title: ThinkNEO API Key
apiKey.description: Required for authenticated tools (spend tracking, guardrails, policy, budget, alerts, and compliance). Public tools (provider_status, schedule_demo) work without a key. Get yours at https://thinkneo.ai/talk-sales

tools.name: thinkneo_check_spend
tools.description: Check AI spend summary for a workspace, team, or project. Returns cost breakdown by provider, model, and time period. Requires authentication.

period.title: Period
period.description: Time period for the report: today, this-week, this-month, last-month, or custom

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: End date for a custom period in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Only used when period='custom'

group_by.title: Group By
group_by.description: Dimension to group costs by: provider, model, team, or project

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Start date for a custom period in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Only used when period='custom'

tools.name: thinkneo_evaluate_guardrail
tools.description: Evaluate a prompt or text against ThinkNEO guardrail policies before sending it to an AI provider. Returns risk assessment, violations found, and recommendations. Requires authentication.

text.title: Text
text.description: The prompt or text content to evaluate for policy violations (max 32,000 characters)

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace whose guardrail policies to apply for this evaluation

guardrail_mode.title: Guardrail Mode
guardrail_mode.description: Evaluation mode: 'monitor' (log violations only) or 'enforce' (block the request on violation)

tools.name: thinkneo_check_policy
tools.description: Check if a specific model, provider, or action is allowed by the governance policies configured for a workspace. Requires authentication.

model.title: Model
model.description: AI model name to check (e.g., gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-6, gemini-2.0-flash)

action.title: Action
action.description: Specific action to check (e.g., create-completion, use-tool, fine-tune)

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: AI provider to check (e.g., openai, anthropic, google, mistral)

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace name or ID whose governance policies to check against

tools.name: thinkneo_get_budget_status
tools.description: Get current budget utilization and enforcement status for a workspace. Shows spend vs limit, alert thresholds, and projected overage. Requires authentication.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace name or ID to retrieve current budget status for

tools.name: thinkneo_list_alerts
tools.description: List active alerts and incidents for a workspace. Includes budget alerts, policy violations, guardrail triggers, and provider issues. Requires authentication.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of alerts to return (1–100)

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Filter alerts by severity level: critical, warning, info, or all

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace name or ID to list active alerts for

tools.name: thinkneo_get_compliance_status
tools.description: Get compliance and audit readiness status for a workspace. Shows governance score, pending actions, and compliance gaps. Requires authentication.

framework.title: Framework
framework.description: Compliance framework to assess: soc2 (SOC 2 Type II), gdpr (GDPR), hipaa (HIPAA), or general (ThinkNEO AI governance)

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace name or ID to evaluate compliance readiness for

tools.name: thinkneo_provider_status
tools.description: Get real-time health and performance status of AI providers routed through the ThinkNEO gateway. Shows latency, error rates, and availability. No authentication required.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Specific provider to check: openai, anthropic, google, mistral, xai, cohere, or together. Omit to get status for all providers.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Workspace context for provider routing configuration (optional)

tools.name: thinkneo_schedule_demo
tools.description: Schedule a demo or discovery call with the ThinkNEO team. Collects contact information and preferences. No authentication required.

role.title: Role
role.description: Contact's role: cto, cfo, security, engineering, or other

email.title: Email
email.description: Business email address to receive follow-up from the ThinkNEO team

context.title: Context
context.description: Additional context such as current AI providers used, request volume, or specific use case

interest.title: Interest
interest.description: Primary area of interest: guardrails, finops, observability, governance, or full platform

contact_name.title: Contact Name
contact_name.description: Full name of the person requesting the demo

preferred_dates.title: Preferred Dates
preferred_dates.description: Preferred meeting dates, times, and timezone (e.g., 'Tuesdays or Thursdays, 9-11am EST')

resources.name: ThinkNEO Getting Started
resources.description: Quick-start guide for connecting your AI applications to the ThinkNEO control plane.

resources.name: Supported AI Providers
resources.description: List of AI providers supported by the ThinkNEO gateway with available models.

prompts.name: thinkneo_governance_audit
prompts.description: Run a full governance audit for a workspace: check budget status, list active alerts, and review compliance readiness.

prompts.name: thinkneo_policy_preflight
prompts.description: Pre-flight check before switching to a new AI model or provider: verify it's allowed by workspace policy and evaluate guardrail compliance.
